versions.subject: Add file_event_win_susp_double_extension
versions.detection:
selection_gen:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
        - '.zip'
        - '.rar'
        - '.lnk'
        - '.iso'
        - '.exe'
    TargetFilename|contains:
        - '.doc.'
        - '.docx.'
        - '.xls.'
        - '.xlsx.'
        - '.ppt.'
        - '.pptx.'
        - '.jpg.'
selection_exe:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
        - '.zip.exe'
        - '.rar.exe'   
filter:
    TargetFilename|contains:
        - '\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Office\Recent\'
        - '\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Windows\Recent\'
condition: 1 of selection_* and not filter
versions.spl: (TargetFilename IN ("*.zip", "*.rar", "*.lnk", "*.iso", "*.exe") TargetFilename IN ("*.doc.*", "*.docx.*", "*.xls.*", "*.xlsx.*", "*.ppt.*", "*.pptx.*", "*.jpg.*")) OR TargetFilename IN ("*.zip.exe", "*.rar.exe") NOT (TargetFilename IN ("*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Office\\Recent\\*", "*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Recent\\*"))
